definition: Written definitions, independent bindings, block/control headers and form statements; ordinary nested expressions and implicit work are not expanded.
conditional_expressions: if, if-let, cond and case remain expressions in every position. A standalone expression has one statement carrier; a definition, initializer or argument absorbs it. Explicit nested blocks remain visible.
loops: One header includes iterator/state bindings. All initializer/range expressions are checked. Body forms count independently.
bindings: One let header and one owner per independent target/initializer pair. True destructuring with one initializer remains one binding; defaults are traversed.
functions: A single syntactic body expression belongs to its definition. Multiple body forms and explicit do/let/control blocks stay visible. This is not semantic purity analysis.
reify_methods: Class and method definitions count. Only scalar method parameter symbols qualify; destructuring/defaults fail closed.
native_evidence: Clojure1.12.6 plus pinned tools.reader1.6.0, read-eval disabled, custom/default tag readers removed, no application evaluation or macroexpand. Full native read trace is bound to a separate lossless source-form tree.
limits: Exact reviewed source hashes and explicit fixtures only
Reader acceptance is not compilation or correctness qualification
